description: Jordan is coordinating the planting of a living memorial for their late grandmother and must make the final call about the tree, planting site, date, and ongoing care after checking in with three relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family wants to plant one living memorial for their late grandmother in the shared backyard.
shared_context.S2: Jordan is coordinating the choice of tree, planting arrangements, and care plan.
shared_context.S3: The backyard has an open east lawn, a shaded north wall, and an existing paved path.
shared_context.S4: The family has set aside one Saturday morning for planting and wants the memorial to be easy for relatives to visit.
shared_context.S5: Before finalizing the plan, Jordan routinely checks with everyone involved for preferences, practical limits, and information they have gathered.

PF1.text: Mira has the last note Grandma wrote about the memorial: Grandma specifically wanted a native serviceberry planted at the east edge of the lawn, with no plaque attached to the trunk.

PF2.text: Theo called the local nursery and learned that the reserved serviceberry will be ready for pickup only on Saturday, April 17, 2027; the nursery will hold it until noon that day. He has not shared this call with the family yet.

PF3.text: Camila asked an arborist to review a photo of the yard. The arborist recommended planting the serviceberry at least 2 meters from the paved path and watering it twice a week for its first eight weeks.

acceptance_conditions: The memorial tree must be a serviceberry.
The tree must be planted at the east edge of the lawn.
The tree must be at least 2 meters from the paved path.
The tree must be watered twice per week for the first eight weeks.
No plaque may be attached to the trunk.
A commitment to collect and plant the reserved tree on April 17, 2027 must exist.
Grandma's memorial preference must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['planting_site'] == 'east_edge_of_lawn' or decisions['planting_site'] == 'east edge of the lawn' or decisions['planting_site'] == 'east edge of the open lawn' or decisions['planting_site'] == 'east edge of the lawn, at least 2 meters from the paved path' or decisions['planting_site'] == 'east edge of the open lawn, at least 2 meters from the paved path'
content_checks.C3: decisions['planting_date'] == '2027-04-17' or decisions['planting_date'] == 'Saturday, April 17, 2027' or decisions['planting_date'] == 'April 17, 2027'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'pickup' or c['type'] == 'pickup_and_plant' or c['type'] == 'pickup_and_plant_reserved_tree' or c['type'] == 'schedule_planting' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Grandma's note changes the tree choice to serviceberry, the site to the east edge of the lawn, and the plaque decision to false instead of leaving all three choices open.
The nursery call changes the planting date to exactly April 17, 2027 and makes a pickup or pickup-and-plant commitment for the reserved tree on that date necessary.
The arborist's recommendation changes the plan to at least 2 meters from the path and exactly two watering days per week for the first eight weeks.
